sectionSubtitle: My professional journey — from formative internships to production SaaS projects.

experiences.summary: End-to-end design, development and deployment of a B2B2C SaaS hotel management platform (PMS) — LuxTech.

modal.context: Luxpure entrusted me with the complete development of LuxTech, a SaaS PMS (Property Management System) for the Moroccan hotel industry. I handled the full cycle: from architecture design to production deployment on OVHcloud, covering all features development.
missions: Designed the complete technical architecture (REST API Back-end + SPA Front-end)
Developed the Hotel PMS module: rooms, room types, equipment, interactive booking calendar
Developed the Agency Portal: hotel search engine, multi-step booking wizard
Developed the public Booking Engine: direct reservations for end customers
Integrated Stripe payments (Checkout, Webhooks, failure handling)
Set up real-time notifications via WebSockets (Laravel Reverb)
Automated PDF invoice generation and email delivery
Configured Queue Workers and Scheduler (automatic room status updates, reminders)
Deployed to production on OVHcloud VPS (Ubuntu), SSH and MySQL configuration
architecture: Back-end: Laravel 12 REST API — Service-oriented architecture for complex business logic
Front-end: React + Vite SPA — domain-based modular structure (Agency, Hotel, Public)
Real-time: WebSockets via Laravel Reverb for notifications and PMS calendar
Security: Laravel Sanctum (API tokens), role middleware (Admin, Hotel, Agency)
3 distinct environments: Hotel Dashboard (PMS), B2B Agency Portal, Public Booking Engine
modal.deployment: Deployed on OVHcloud VPS (Ubuntu 22.04) via SSH. Production MySQL server configuration, sensitive environment variables management (Stripe, Google Maps, ReCaptcha, Reverb). Hosted at luxtech.ma.

experiences.summary: Full design and development of a B2B economic intelligence platform: corporate website, secure client portal and admin back-office with Ellisphere API integration for financial analysis of French companies.

modal.context: Freelance mission for NEO Solutions (Morocco, French client): a firm specializing in business intelligence, due diligence, compliance and cybersecurity. The project covered two parts: an institutional website and a full business platform allowing professional clients to search and analyze French companies via the Ellisphere API, with an in-depth investigation workflow managed on the admin side.
missions: Development of the NEO Solutions institutional website (Home, About, Services, Contact, Client Portal pages)
development of the secure client platform: authentication, dashboard, company search engine
Integration of the Ellisphere API to retrieve financial data (SIREN, financial statements, executives, solvency scores)
Development of the Search module: search by SIREN, company name, executive, department or business sector with confidence score (0-10, displayed as 0 to 5 stars)
Development of the Investigation Services module: inquiry request form (3 types + custom), status tracking
Development of the admin back-office: incoming inquiry management with pre-filled Word document generation from Ellisphere data, notifications and delivery workflow
Security of access and sensitive financial data (authentication, client/admin roles)
architecture: Monolithic Laravel architecture: integrated back-end and front-end, no client-side API exposed (direct DB access)
Front-end: React + TypeScript SPA for the client dashboard and admin back-office
Ellisphere API integration: 3 custom XML products — PRELYSE (main data), financial statements (last 3 years), BODACC updates (collective proceedings)
Investigation workflow: client request > admin notification > pre-filled Word generation from Ellisphere data > admin completion > client delivery
MySQL database: financial data modeling, consulted companies, client portfolios, audit history

experiences.role: Full Stack Developer — Final Year Internship
experiences.summary: Final year internship: full rebuild of a desktop automotive claims management app into a modern Laravel web application, with automated emails, notifications and cost calculations.

modal.context: Final Year Project (PFE) internship at M2S – Mondial Solution Services, an IT consulting and development firm based in Casablanca. The existing .NET Desktop application had critical limitations: single-machine access, poor ergonomics and no automation. The mission was to design and develop from scratch a modern Laravel web application to meet the specific requirements of the automotive insurance industry.
missions: Analysis of the existing .NET Desktop application and specification of functional and non-functional requirements
Development of a secure authentication page with role management (insurance experts)
Development of the per-company insurance dashboard: visual statistics (pie and bar charts), key indicators (created, late, refused, validated claims), AGT return list and assessors list
Development of the full claim file creation workflow: multi-step form (creation > documents > scheduling > decision)
Document management: multiple PDF and image uploads, PDF-to-image conversion (ImageMagick), full-screen viewer with zoom and rotation
AGT scheduling module: interactive calendar, automatic agent selection by geographic zone
Cost assessment module: supplier management (parts), labor by impact type, automatic HT/VAT/TTC calculations
Decision pop-up: file status change, predefined reasons, 2nd status field, free observations
Status history timeline: chronological display of the complete evolution of each file
Email automation: periodic detection of pending emails, pop-up display with attachments, send/reject by expert.
Follow-up automation: detection of late files and automatic generation of reminders
architecture: Laravel 9 MVC architecture: strict separation of Model-View-Controller to isolate business logic, presentation and data access
SQL Server database (SSMS) modeled for insurance claims: File, Contract, Follow-up, Scheduling, Cost Assessment, Supplier, Labor, Impact Points, File States
Front-end: HTML/CSS/JavaScript + jQuery (Select2, AJAX, dynamic validation, animations) + Tailwind CSS
PHP extensions used: hash (security), Imagick (PDF to image), pdo_sqlsrv / sqlsrv (SQL Server connection)
Agile Scrum methodology: 2-3 week sprints, regular reviews, meetings every 3 days
Project tracking: Gantt chart (GanttProject), UML modeling (Lucidchart)

experiences.summary: Built from scratch a web application for Master's cycle academic management: students, teachers, courses, grades, absences and schedules.

modal.context: Internship at the Faculty of Sciences and Techniques of Errachidia (FST): design and development from scratch of a web-based academic management application dedicated to the Master's cycle. The goal was to digitize and centralize the department's administrative processes — replacing manual procedures with a modern web solution accessible to students, teachers and administrative staff.
missions: Analysis of functional and non-functional requirements with the Master's department
UML modeling: use case diagram (actors: Student, Admin/Manager) and class diagram
Design and modeling of the MySQL database (students, teachers, modules, grades, absences, courses)
Development of the Authentication module: registration, secure login, student space and admin space
Development of the Student Management module: viewing and updating personal and academic information
Development of the Courses & Announcements module: course material distribution, publication of notices to students
Development of the Grades & Evaluations module: grade entry by module, student consultation
Development of the Absence Tracking module: attendance/absence monitoring per student and per module
Development of the Schedule module: timetable planning and display by Master's track
architecture: Laravel MVC architecture: Controllers / Models / Views separation to isolate business logic, data access and presentation
MySQL database: relational modeling (Student, Teacher, Module, Grade, Absence, Course, Schedule)
Front-end: HTML5 / CSS3 + jQuery for dynamic interactions (form validation, AJAX loading, conditional rendering)
Two distinct spaces: Student Space (grades, courses, absences, notices) and Admin Space (full academic data management)
